subject: STABLE texture-opus #8: cube / cube-array / 3D / 1D / 1D-array / MS sampled through the specialized planner; host cdylib a67bae84 + receipt; DEVICE: iOS Rust staticlib must be rebuilt
body: Frontend (render_encoder.inc 699343d8): general allocation adds 1D/1DArray (one row a level) and 3D (slice-major levels, any n2t colour format, levelDepth/slice stride per level); bindable + v2 sidecar layouts for kinds 0/1/7 (3D no longer only the exact R55 R8 64x64 class). Planner (air_bridge.rs e098979e): specialized path admits 1D, 1DArray, Cube, CubeArray, 3D, 2DMS, 2DMSArray (bounded like rich_array: <=256 layer*levels). Test: NEW gpu/tests/shaders/texture_types_probe.ll 0ee8fd6d (authored AIR: cube/3D/1D/2Darray fragment samplers), texture_format_frontend_test bde032ac asserts TEXTURE_TYPES drawn=8 of 8 (incl. mip chains). Gates: render harness PASS, CA test PASS 41, ycbcr PASS, integration 1005/2 (known CA only, candidate_ok True with the regenerated receipt), run_host_tests: all host stages PASS incl. bridge test (fixed by its owner); the final 'actual iOS bundle strict link' fails with 'undefined symbol: tegu_air_render_pipeline_immutable_sampler' because research/nord2-native-air/.../libtegu_air_bridge.a (20:53) predates air_bridge.rs #3 -> root: rebuild with build_native_compilers.py air before the next device build (strong symbol, by design a stale archive cannot link). MS sampling (texture2d_ms read) is admitted but not yet covered by an authored AIR case. Snapshot gpu/build/texture-coverage-20261026/p8-types-stable.
